reviews.text: Once I'm in the door, I breathe a sigh of relief after the struggle of getting the cats in the carriers. I feel in excellent hands with the team at Juno. My regular vet, Dr Rifkind is so gentle and kind with my guys in addition to being a true pro. The entire team is so efficient and caring, and really responsive. This past visit I had a dental issue with one of my cats as he was in discomfort and I decided on a dental procedure. Dani, an RVT asked me really great questions and walked me through the procedure and potential costs thoroughly and checking in for concerns on my part. During the cat's surgery, I was kept fully informed and post-procedure the team followed up and checked in frequently. My go-to for my guys. I love the Juno App. Thanks Juno!
Great conversation！

No understanding of the FortiFlora Pro product. I was told that I need a prescription. No, you don't. Maybe in the US, but not in Canada. They were just trying to make money, which is so typical of large companies run by greedy people!
Sky thanks you
This was my first visit with my new rescue. She was welcomed with love and cuddles. There is always such a good vibe at Juno.

EDIT: Adding to my initial wellness check / vaxx review. Second visit was due to a painful paw pad abscess and resulting mobility issues. Extremely pleased with Dr Nodden's choice of antibiotic treatment and clever selection of antibiotic topical. The speed of healing is remarkable. Felix was functional after just 1 day of treatment. At 3 day mark, he's 90 percent back to normal apart from having to limit his walks. Frontline staff was also great in person and on the phone.

Initial Review: Pleasant surprise having my first appointment at this Juno Vet location. Selected mostly due to short distance and good reviews, I was just hoping the vet care matches the beautiful, colorful interior. Thankfully, I was not disappointed. I really appreciated that the vet, Dr Hylton, was able to match my information driven vibe. Also loved the way she did the exam, while chatting with me and casually interacting with the dog - he barely realized he was being examined. The clinic also had an overall calm atmosphere. Not an issue for my attention hogging Labbie, but I could see it how it is a good environment for more anxious doggies. Everything was well thought out, starting from the subdivided seating area where multiple pets can sit with their owners without interacting, to a complete bill of health writeup sent by email right after the appointment. And nice upmarket sodas for owners, yay. Just one reco: I missed seeing a water station for the dogs (although you can take a free water bottle and give them water outside, I guess)

I’m extremely disappointed by how my dog and our family were treated here.

In the first year of my dog’s life alone, we’ve spent over $4,500 at this clinic. Despite being regular clients, there is very little continuity of care, you generally see whichever veterinarian is available rather than building a relationship with one vet who consistently follows your dog. For a clinic this expensive, I expected a much more personal and compassionate experience.

Our most recent visit was the final straw. My dog has an ear problem that we were genuinely worried about. Following the clinic’s instructions, I gave him two trazodone tablets and withheld his breakfast before an early Saturday morning appointment. The medication left him extremely sedated, the attached photo is how he looked that morning.

I woke my son early on his last weekend of summer break, we skipped breakfast ourselves, and rearranged our Saturday because getting our dog’s ear looked at was important to us. We unfortunately arrived about 10 minutes late. Despite there still being approximately 20 minutes left in the appointment, we were simply told he would not be seen and needed to be rescheduled.

I explained that he was sitting there heavily sedated and hungry because we had followed their instructions for this appointment, and pleaded with them to at least have someone look at his ear. I wasn’t demanding a full appointment if there genuinely wasn’t enough time. I was asking for a little compassion and help determining whether his ear needed urgent attention.

That compassion was completely missing.

I understand having policies around late arrivals. What I cannot understand is having a dog sitting in your clinic sedated and fasted at your instruction, with an owner asking for help, and showing so little flexibility or empathy.

After spending thousands of dollars here, I walked away feeling that this clinic prioritizes policies and business efficiency over compassion and the relationship between a veterinarian, a pet and their family. Based on our experience, I cannot recommend this clinic. We will be taking our dog elsewhere and looking for a practice that offers greater continuity of care, empathy and a more personal approach.

I am so happy I found this clinic and booked an appointment for my kitten Maple. He was treated with extreme care and love by everyone in the staff! Dr. Doug went above and beyond to treat my little baby! Thank you to all the team for the extreme care with Maple and all the patience and information about what needed to be done.
Recommend Juno Veterinary 1000%!!

We recently made the switch to Juno because our previous vet's location was no longer convenient, and I am so glad we did! Everyone here was exceptionally nice, friendly, and professional.

My Pomsky, Luna, gets quite skittish at the vet, but the team took such great care of her and went above and beyond to keep her comfortable. They were also super thorough with me, making sure I understood everything happening during the visit. The facility itself is spotless and modern. The complimentary swag bag was such a sweet, unexpected touch!

If you're looking for a top-tier veterinary clinic, I highly recommend Juno. Luna and I couldn't be happier with our experience!
I love this place. Great atmosphere. My dog loves it too. Great care.

I don’t trust people who don’t trust animals.  Entrusting the team at Juno with the care of two cartoon-like Siamese cats is one of the best decisions I've made.  I trust them completely.

It doesn’t matter if you have two or four paws, the people at Juno Summerhill understand that a visit to the Vet can be unsettling and scary.  Can be … but, rarely is at Juno.  Everyone (Reception, Techs and the Vet staff) is exceptional: professional, thoughtful, patient, knowledgeable and kind.  Plus, they honestly love animals.

For clients with only two paws, the most frightening part of a vet-visit usually happens right after being asked: “how would you like to pay?”  Since joining Juno, my response is always “with thanks”.

Incredible veterinary care. Third dog, know my vets like Secord and Rosedale, and this is by far the best. Fair pricing, incredible staff and doctors and I adore the 24 hour accessibility if necessary. Not to mention there is a tuck shop for the patients! Couldn’t recommend this more.
They are very friendly and professional!

My experience overall has been positive at this clinic. However, I feel as though you do not get the premium service for the premium price you pay here.

I got my pet neutered here, and all interactions were through RVT. Although they are all nice and I imagine knowledgeable, what I am paying for is an appointment with the vet not the technician. I think that an essential part of running a business like this building a good client relationship between the primary vet and pet/parents — but how is it possible without seeing the vet at all?

I understand I am able to request an appointment with the vet at any time, but I would appreciate a more forward approach and care from the vet. Throughout the whole neuter procedure I did not even see the vet once, not for the pre op, post op or on surgery day. Wouldn’t customers feel more comfortable meeting the vet who is operating on their pet and having a conversation with them prior/post surgery? I don’t think text messaging will suffice, which is what I received.

I feel as though I am not valued as a client or cared for by any of the vets here.
I loved how friendly and welcoming the staff were. They made such a great impression that I drove all the way from Sudbury to visit again.
Amir, thanks for taking time to share your thoughts with us. We are always happy to see you and your loved ones in the clinic!
Hi Veronika, thank you so much for sharing your experience with us. We are so glad you had a great experience and can’t wait to see you again!

Can’t recommend Dr Bianca and the whole team enough!! My puppy really went through it a few months ago and almost died, and another vet exacerbated her symptoms, so we switched vets to start seeing Dr Bianca and never looked back. Dr Bianca and team checked in on us every single day for months, knowing how sick my girl was. They were right there with us every step of the way, including Christmas Eve when she landed in the emergency hospital and they called just to check on us. They are deeply empathetic and thoughtful, extremely talented and qualified, and there’s no one else I would ever trust. Even months later they still check up on us, and also check on me as a dog mom 🤍
We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with us and are so glad you had such a great experience!

I was so impressed with Juno Vet Summerhill’s staff and Dr. Rifkind (in their care of Momma) that I also took my feral male cat Walter Earthquake for a wellness check. This handful melted in the Dr/staff’s gentle, skilled hands. As the pet owner, I felt fully assured that Walter would receive the best, least stressful path for his health journey. I have had a lot of vet visits and vet bills in caring for feral cats over the past 20 years and can say that Juno demonstrates dedicated, ethical and professional practice. So very glad I chose Juno Veterinary Summerhill.

******************************************
Juno Veterinary Summerhill checks all the boxes for me. Excellent hours, engaged/supportive/professional staff, clean and well organized environment and excellent care for my 17 year old cranky feral cat Momma (aka Crustifera). So very grateful to Dr. Rifkind and staff for their patience and skill in handling Momma and her cantankerous crustiness. As Mommas servant, I felt confident and at ease knowing she was well attended to. Try Juno Vet Summerhill for yourself and see.

I cannot recommend Juno Veterinary Clinic highly enough. The care that my cats, Mia, Chloe, and Sasha, have received has been nothing short of exceptional.

A very special thank you to Dr. Sierra, who is truly an outstanding veterinarian. She is incredibly knowledgeable, compassionate, patient, and genuinely dedicated to the health and well-being of every pet she treats. She always takes the time to explain everything thoroughly, answer all of my questions, and ensure I feel informed and comfortable with every treatment decision.

The entire team at Juno Veterinary Clinic is simply amazing. From the reception staff to the veterinary technicians, everyone is warm, welcoming, professional, and truly cares about both the animals and their families. Every visit is met with kindness, compassion, and outstanding service.

Knowing that Mia, Chloe, and Sasha are in such caring and capable hands gives me tremendous peace of mind. Thank you, Dr. Sierra, and the entire Juno Veterinary Clinic team for the exceptional care you provide every day. I wholeheartedly recommend Juno Veterinary Clinic to anyone looking for a veterinary team that treats your pets as if they were their own.
They sell Revolution plus for tick prevention but it’s marked up 100%. Very pricey. Big business model, not as claimed…
Thank you so much for sharing your experience with us. We are so glad you had a great experience and can’t wait to see you again!
We had a very welcoming and positive experience! Buckley loves his Juno ball! Thank you!

My daughter switched to Juno in Toronto (she has a precious chihuahua) and the service and environment is amazing. The vets and staff are attentive, compassionate and highly skilled. Looking for them to expand to Alberta so I can enjoy the same benefits for my fur babies🫶 …

Dr.Bianca Ferlisi is amazing. When I first brought my puppy she explained everything from immunization schedule, developmental milestones and how to take care of my puppy. The front desk staff are always welcoming and friendly. Additionally all of the vet techs have been fantastic and take the time to explain what's happening. I felt that Juno has been very transparent about prices and for the first time since having a dog I feel calm going to the vet because I know exactly what I'm paying for and what to expect. I genuinely feel the staff care about the animals and owners.

Very recently my dog (shepherd/husky) was very sick with open pryomtra. She stopped eating for 10 days. I contacted the hotline and as a result, Taylor, the clinic manager contacted me directly with concerns for Samie (my dog) and she also showed care and understanding about my anxiety and emotions. I went to the clinic and was greeted with the utmost care. The veterinarian was absolutely professional, caring, understanding as well as informative. Samie was well taken of and I left a lot happier than when I walked in. The entire staff is to be commended for everything. Thank you again Juno.

As the owner of two cats, Juno has become our go-to veterinary clinic. We bring our cats here for their regular checkups and care, and every visit has been a positive experience. The clinic is clean, modern, and welcoming, and the staff are always kind, professional, and patient with our pets. I appreciate their transparency, communication, and the convenience of accessing reports and test results online.
Very kind and efficient service all around
Hi Jasmine, thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We would love the opportunity to discuss your experience further so we can continue to improve our services.
The whole experience was professional and caring. I appreciate the time everyone took to take our info and get to know us on our first visit.

my rescue dog, mikoya, went to juno vet for the first time this week.
dr. biana, taylor and stacy were all friendly and very patient with mikoya who is a very timid dog.  i am very happy with the care that mikoya received.
Hi Jessica, thank you so much for sharing your experience with us. We are so glad you had a great experience and can’t wait to see you and Rosie again!

I have been going to Juno for years. When I asked them for a dewormer they said they can’t dispense it without seeing my dog again. So they want me to bring over my healthy dog (who had all tests done 2 months prior), to tell me “oh your dog is healthy” here is your dewormer, that will be $250? Like come on. They were my primary vet, when I need a dewormer refill I need to pay for a vet to see my dog?

In addition to that, they charge $445 for travel health certificate ($265 travel certificate, $129 vet visit, + tax) for signing a paper that takes them literally 5 minutes to fill out. I went to another vet and did it for $80.

Their online paid service is completely useless too because they pretend to want to help and they never actually help in most inquiries — it always converges into wanting to bring you in to make you pay for a visit + upsell you on services.

Blatant robbery. Ridiculous organization.

Just go to some local vet, they will treat you better with more respect.

Brought my cat in for a vet visit. Clean facilities. Vet was approachable, kind and explained the issues clearly. Showed me upfront pricing when asked and didnt pressure me into any treatment. The front desk staff were hospitable. We will be back, great first easy experience at their facilities.
The staff at Juno were so welcome and calm with our pup. Thank you!
Thank you, Juno (Summerhill) for excellent care and your wonderful staff.

I had such a great experience here I'm so glad I found Juno. The space itself is really clean & lovely and my dog received excellent care. They didn't freak me out or try to upsell me on anything, just quickly sorted him out. It was very efficient and productive. Staff was warm & friendly, will definitely be going back.

Our dog has been a client of Juno Summerhill for over 3 years.  We visit every day for a quick treat and a hello.  We visit other times as necessary.  From the Customer Service team at the front desk, to the vet techs and the Vets we have always been treated with kindness and first rate care.  Thank you for looking after all of us so we'll.

It’s been a few month  that I’ve been going to that clinic with Tizia. They’re always so professional and try to accommodate me. I really appreciate that. Plus, Tizia always looks like she’s having the time of her life, as you can see in the pictures lol.

The things I really enjoyed is the fact that when you pick up your pet, you have that little meeting with the vet explaining everything that went down from the time of drop-off, and the encounter summary that they send me after each visit.

Shoutout to Dr Doug!!
Hi Giancarlo, thank you so much for sharing your experience with us. We are so glad you had a great experience and can’t wait to see you again!

What an excellent experience. Something I never thought I'd say after having to say goodbye to a beloved pet. All staff including Dr. Bianca went above and beyond to make one of the hardest days of our lives easier. Thank you
We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback, we can't wait to see you again!

We were looking for a new vet for our cat, Ferrero and stumbled upon this place. Everything was a 10/10… the staff was so nice and went out of their way to make sure Ferrero felt comfortable. Cannot recommend this place enough!

Great experience from the start!  booking the appointment is super easy via the app, the welcome at the clinic is always so friendly and the vets and everyone working at the clinic are so kind, helpful and sweet.
Great vets! Really professional people here who care about your pet(s). Great environment for people and pets while you’re waiting for your appointment.

I'm looking for a vet in the area but after calling this clinic, I’ve decided to look elsewhere. The person who answered the phone was quite dismissive and made me feel like an inconvenience.
I was told I couldn't get detailed information without first paying for an exam. Save your time and find a vet that actually values prospective clients.

My first interactions with Juno has been really positive.  I originally booked my first appointment using their app for a simple wellness / vaccine visit.  My pup then unexpected had a ruptured cyst.  I used their virtual 24/7 chat and they found an appointment the next morning.  Their Summerhill clinic is clean, modern and even had free drinks.  The vet tech who first saw my pup was polite, professional and explained the cost.  I then saw Dr. Doug and he was also really nice and patient.  They outlined the procedure and took good care of pup.  There was no pressure to add on extra services, and I even received a summary email  that outlined his medical records and the visit.  So far I'm happy that I switched Vets.  Juno is modern, convenient, has a great clinic and the staff seem terrific.
great doctor and staff.  Easy online booking and very reasonable pricing

I can’t say enough good things about Juno Vet Summerhill. They took such amazing care of my Shiba Inu, Winnie, when she cracked her dewclaw. From the moment we walked in, the team was incredibly compassionate, friendly, and genuinely reassuring. The receptionist even took a moment to make me a hot cup of coffee on a freezing cold day which I felt was very thoughtful.

They explained everything clearly and made sure I felt fully informed about her treatment and recovery, which meant a lot. You can tell they truly care — not just about the pets, but about the owners too.

They also submitted my insurance claim right away, so there were no delays in getting my reimbursement. That kind of efficiency takes so much stress off during an already worrying situation.

And the sweetest touch? They added a little piece of artwork on Winnie’s cast. It was such a small detail, but it absolutely made my day and shows how much heart they put into what they do.

Highly recommend Juno Vet Summerhill to anyone looking for compassionate, thorough, and thoughtful care. Winnie and I are so grateful! 🐾🐶💕
Very professional and decisive treatment. Flexible with my tardiness. And very understanding of the urgency and complexity of cat’s health.

Juno Vet was absolutely amazing for our first visit with our new puppy. As a first-time puppy owner, I had a lot of questions and concerns, especially things my breeder had told me that I wanted to discuss. The team truly listened, never dismissed my concerns, and took the time to educate me in a calm, respectful, and reassuring way.

They were so gentle and caring with my puppy and showed so much compassion throughout the entire visit. You can immediately tell that everyone who works there genuinely cares about animals. They’ve clearly done an incredible job building a team that is both knowledgeable and kind.

I left feeling confident, informed, and so relieved knowing my puppy is in such good hands. I couldn’t recommend Juno Vet more, especially for first-time puppy owners. 🐾

I’ve been bringing my dog, Coco Love, to Juno Veterinary – Summerhill for the past few years and have consistently had an outstanding experience. Dr. Rael Rifkind is an exceptional veterinarian — highly skilled, thoughtful, and incredibly compassionate. He has performed two procedures for Coco, a dental surgery and a recent biopsy, and in both cases he took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and made me feel completely confident that she was in the best possible hands.

I also want to sincerely thank Tara for the wonderful care and thoughtful updates during Coco’s recovery. The entire team is attentive, kind, and genuinely cares about their patients. I’m very grateful for the consistent, high-quality care Coco Love has received and highly recommend Juno Summerhill.

During a recent visit, my dog nipped the vet while reaching for a treat. The vet explicitly told me that if I provided proof of rabies vaccination, no further action would be taken (vaccination was done at our main vet). I did exactly what was asked, yet he still filed a report with Public Health! This led to a huge hassle involving city officials that was completely unnecessary. If you value a vet who keeps their word and doesn't overreact, look elsewhere. I will not be returning to Juno.

I don’t typically leave reviews, but my experience today at Juno Summerhill was unmatched. I brought my newly adopted cat, Bonette to them for the first time today and I must say the entire visit was extremely pleasant. They took good care with Bonette, feeding her a treat to help keep her feeling relaxed, a new toy with some catnip and lots of loving pets and words of affirmation (even tho she’s a deaf kitty, haha!)

After going to a different vet when I first adopted Bonette with no upfront pricing and honestly just making me feel very pressured into doing things, Juno was truly a breath of fresh air. They’re not money grabbers and it feels as though they genuinely want what’s best for my girl. I’m so overly happy with our experience, they have definitely gained a new forever patient. Thank you to Dr Bianca Ferlisi, the vet tech (I’m sorry I can’t remember her name!) she worked with and the 2 ladies up front.

We both had such a wonderful experience. Thank you!!
Do not come here! I walked in with a sick dog who was visibly bleeding and was told “we are all booked up, we be happy to see her in three days when we have availability for a follow up.”
We love Juno Vet. Love how millennial friendly they are :)

First of all, it was great to have a Sunday appointment. So convenient!
The atmosphere was so calm and inviting.
Kessler seemed to enjoy his visit with Dr Doyle-Baker. So knowledgeable and kind.
The vet tech was wonderful too.I am happy that I moved to Juno.

Best vet I have ever been to. Not only is the place clean and spotless. They give you complimentary treats for your pet, and coffee or sparking water for the owner.

Our vet Brett was amazing! They gave complete treatment within 40 minutes and left us feeling very confident. Not only that but their prices were lower than our previous vet and we got $75 off and some complimentary services for our first visit.

Service and knowledge 5/5
I wish the price was more reasonable.

The team at Juno Vet (Summerhill) is amazing. The clinic is super clean and welcoming, and the staff is incredibly friendly, helpful and kind. My puppy didn’t even notice her vaccine!  That’s how gentle they are. Our vet took the time to answer all my questions with sooo much patience. (Thanks, Dr. Bianca!!) Booking is really easy and their 24/7 app support is such a huge plus. My puppy and I are so happy with our experience. Definitely recommend!
Amy, thanks for taking time to share your thoughts so eloquently with us. We are always happy to see you and your loved ones in the clinic!
Hi Taylor! Thank you for sharing such wonderful feedback about your visit with us. We can’t wait to see you again!

Hi Caitlin,
We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback and are so glad you had a great experience!
Hi Jillian, thank you for sharing such wonderful feedback about your visit with us. We are happy to hear that you are pleased with our service and care and that you had a positive experience!
Juno is the best!! My dog used to hate going to the vet before we switched and now he loves everyone at Juno - They truly put your pet first. I can't recommend them enough!

I had such a bad experience with Juno. The staff is extremely arrogant and rude, especially the receptionist. For them, it’s just a business — no empathy, no common sense, and absolutely no care for their customers nor pets. All they seem to want is your money.

They were so rude that after visiting just once, I immediately closed my account. I would never recommend this place to anyone.

We went to Juno seeing the google reviews. Extremely disappointed with the front staff and the vet. They have limited knowledge for a kitten, no absolute care for the pet was provided. Even when you show your dissatisfaction they don’t even try to apologise for try to make things better. POOR MANAGEMENT when we said we want to close the account not even once did they try to retain us I am glad we decided to walk away from JUNO before any further delay.

You guys beed to take care of your customers or keep your ego high and loose the business.

Juno Veterinary is simply the best. After years of going to various clinics that are part of a larger, more aggressive chain of vets offices, Juno was a breath of fresh air.

The staff was extremely friendly and helpful at putting my cat (and me) at ease the whole time I was there. The upfront pricing is refreshing, and I appreciated the fact that the staff allowed me to pick and choose what procedures I would have done right away and what I could defer to being done at a future date based both the doctor's recommendation and my comfort with the proposed procedure. No pressure at all was applied to do procedures I wasn't comfortable with.

Same day appointments that you book online are incredibly convenient!

The thoroughness of their follow-up service is second to none.

They seemed unconcerned about corporate obligations and minimums. I really feel that my cat's needs are their first priority.
We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with us and are so glad you had such a great experience! We can’t wait to see you, Whitney and Oliver again!
Hi Shilpa, thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We would love the opportunity to discuss your experience further so we can continue to improve our services.
A Caring & Welcoming Environment,  when your fur baby is not well…Highly recommended
Love Juno Vet. Excellent care, friendly staff, clean and bight facilities, upfront pricing. It's always a pleasure to visit.

Pathetic and arrogant staff , absolutely no seriousness of services offered. My pet has been a long standing patient since 3 years but off-late the staff seems to have changed. They have no respect for someone’s time, efforts of driving down to the clinic for an hour just to have you turned down for an 10min delay caused due to traffic outside of the clinic , not to mention horrible location ( no parking at all) . Little do they care about the  health of our pet . It’s all show off about the clinic and no real value for money at all . Complete rip off ! DO NOT RECOMMEND THE SUMMERHILL CLINIC AT ALL!
Easy to book, efficient and caring visit, and reasonable prices. Will visit again!
We always have an amazing experience at Juno vet! The staff care about my concerns!
Great experience - friendly, efficient, knowledgable.I love the ability to book via the app.
Everyone is wonderful and the environment is great!
We followed Dr Rifkind to Juno and have been very happy with their model of operating.  The app is fantastic for booking appointments and communication in general.
Wonderful clinic and staff.

Juno Vet has been amazing over the past year. The clinic feels warm, welcoming, and cozy, with genuinely kind and caring staff and doctors. Their 24/7 support through the app is wonderful, with detailed visit reports and all of Buki’s records in one place. Always professional and supportive — it truly gave me peace of mind

I lost my sweet Burmese cat last night…it was her time. What do you do when you’re a 60yo Rheumatologist with nobody around to help? Well the kindness of Juno Vet….empathy, compassion non-plussed. Thank you so much for understanding a weeping man’s heart ♥️ Goodbye Chanel my love!
Very kind and lovely staffs!
Not friendly and nothing special

Our first visit to Juno exceeded my expectations! Dr. Bianca and Nikki made me and my cat feel very welcomed and reduced any anxiety around a first visit.

Juno has made going to the vet fun with all of their treats available and comfortable environment.

Highly recommend if you are looking for a vet!

-Zoë & Leia
Beautiful place. Beautiful People and beautiful service. Highly Recommended.
Thank you

I had an appointment for 8:30, but I arrived at 8:45 because my dog was having a severe diarrhea episode. They refused to see my dog and canceled my appointment. My dog was in a really bad situation, and it's not something a compassionate person would do to a pet. It's disappointing that these individuals are veterinarians. The place itself is beautiful, but it seems more focused on making money than on understanding and caring for animals.

This is the best Vetrinary clinic I’ve ever taken my pets to. They’re so warm and welcoming - no charges are a surprise. They go over every cost before going through with anything. Every employee in the Summerhill clinic is so kind and understanding. 100% recommend

Great first experience at Juno. They were very understanding of our sometimes spicy Calico. Also loved how upfront they were with costs and how we could choose which services we wanted or not. Other vets we’ve gone to typically say what’s needed and there’s the bill. Callie says thank you for all the treats today :)
Thank you, Alex!

I couldn’t dream of better care for my baby. Dr Kiana and team are TOP CLASS when it comes to their profession. I feel so safe, heard and supported when I’m with Dr Kiana. She listens, is compassionate and insanely brilliant. I would trust her with my own health lol 🤣

Thanks Dr Kiana & the Juno Team. Love one of your most frequent patients… Mortimer 🥲❤️
Thank you

First time visiting this place. The check-in process was smooth, and the office was clean.
It was great that they had already retrieved my cat's medical records from the previous vet.
As my cat can get very scared and easily get panic from vet visits, they were able to accommodate the process of blood work and urine check while i was holding my cat.
Bloodwork result was available in two days, and i was able to see the visit report and blood work report through their app as well as the email they sent
Love the staff and the atmosphere. Took their time with us and made our kittens feel right at home with toys and treats.

My experience at this vet clinic was truly outstanding. My cat is usually very difficult to handle and becomes extremely stressed whenever she leaves the house, especially for vet visits.

The team at Juno was not only incredibly kind and professional, but they also went above and beyond to make my cat feel comfortable and safe. They took the time to explain procedures and health concerns that previous vets had never even mentioned, helping me understand some serious risks I had been unaware of.

They allowed her to explore the room and settle in before starting the examination, which made a huge difference in her stress levels.

Now she's back home, loudly meowing at the front door because she wants to go out again... something that has never happened before.

I’m deeply grateful to the entire team, and I will definitely be bringing her back for future care.
Thank you, Prinny

I took my dog Snoopy to Juno Vet trusting he would be in good hands. However, the experience was deeply disappointing. After the staff trimmed his nails, Snoopy began limping and showing clear signs of pain. We immediately contacted the clinic, but not only did they charge us for the follow-up, they also showed a complete lack of empathy. We clearly explained that the pain started right after they handled him, but they showed no concern and took no responsibility.

Snoopy was in perfect condition before that appointment. He is a diabetic dog, and we care for him with great attention. Despite that, they only prescribed some pills, without genuinely addressing his pain or offering any kind of apology.

They suggested doing X-rays, but once again, without any kindness or acknowledgment of the possible harm they had caused. Everything had to be paid out of pocket, as if there was no chance the injury happened under their care.

As a family, we decided to seek a second opinion. At the new clinic, X-rays confirmed a ligament sprain in one of his toes, specifically the one that was manipulated during the nail trimming at Juno Vet.

The most painful part was not just my pet’s physical injury, but the total lack of compassion and accountability in their response. No apology, no responsibility. As a dog owner, seeing my pet suffer while they refused to even consider the possibility of a mistake is simply unacceptable.

I sincerely hope they improve their treatment of both the animals and the people who trust them. The health and well-being of our pets should always be the top priority.
Thank you, Katharene!

I couldn’t ask for a more incredible team looking after my sweet (accident prone) little dog. The attention to detail and care involved when treating her is unmatched. One of my Frenchie’s (Pickle) had an eye infection… Not a big deal, so instead of taking him to his regular vet(who is an hour away), I decided to take him to Juno which is a 15min walk from my home.   During the meeting, I expressed concern that I recently heard of a dog who lost an eye from an eye infection.  I was given eye drops and was told that Pickle had to wear a cone.
I kept him wearing a cone as instructed, but dogs being dogs, Pickle found a way to scratch his infected eye against something and the eye quickly got worse!
I took him in to get it looked at.   They took him to another room to inspect his eye and seconds later I heard an awful shriek from Pickle.  The vet came rushing back into the room to let me know that Pickles eye had “burst”.    Upon hearing that distressing news, all I wanted to, was to make Pickle better and I agreed to have them remove the eye at a cost of $4000!!!
My first issue is that the even after expressing concern/fear that Pickle could lose an eye, the vet still gave me an eye drop that had a possible outcome of exactly that…. The eye drops(TOBRADEX) were a steroid that although they were working, works counterproductive if there is a scratch…. Some dogs are more determined than others and even with a cone, Pickle had scratched his cornea.   Had I known that this was a possible outcome, I would never have used this product when there are others that do not carry this risk!
My second issue is this….  I’m sure that when Pickle was taken to the examination room, he was squirming and his eye got punctured as a result.   This isn’t something I can prove but the experience has left me with the feeling that it DID NOT happen naturally and resulted in the removal of Pickles eye and Juno gets to ring up a 4K service.

Having had pets all my long lifelong, I can testify I have never seen such a combination of kindness and efficiency from the moment you reach them out over the phone until you get a detailed  and clear diagnostic in 24 hours. I feel awesomely grateful!

I don’t usually write reviews, but I’ve been to Juno Vet twice for emergencies with my dog, and both experiences were outstanding. What truly sets them apart is their transparency: they clearly explain services and costs, offer honest recommendations, and never pressure you into optional treatments. The picture is always clear.

The clinic is clean, the staff are polite and knowledgeable, and the vets are thorough. For example, Dr. Bianca even took the time to research the ingredients of a toothpaste we were using during a brief wait—truly going above and beyond!

As someone who takes my dog to the vet whenever necessary, I also appreciate Juno Vet’s balanced approach to care that is so hard to see from some establishments this days. They treat dogs as dogs—not as humans—while still acknowledging their importance as family members. During both visits, they reassured me that while some issues could arise, my dog was overall healthy and in a normal state, eliminating unnecessary worry or humanizing him. Their thoughtful, realistic approach sets them apart and gives me confidence in their professional care. Couldn't recommend more!
